description: Source code for a microsecond timer implementation, including hardware timer setup, callback handling, and a watchdog controller for event scheduling in an embedded system.

classes.name: MicrosecondTimerWatchdogController
classes.description: A periodic controller class that monitors the timer activity and triggers firmware errors if inactivity exceeds expected thresholds.

methods.name: setHardwareUsTimer
methods.description: Sets the hardware timer alarm for a specified number of microseconds from now, handling timer state and errors.

methods.name: hwTimerCallback
methods.description: Callback function invoked when the hardware timer expires, executing the global timer callback and updating metrics.

methods.name: initMicrosecondTimer
methods.description: Initializes and starts the microsecond timer hardware and associated watchdog.
